item.title: India: AI Underpins Vision for Intelligent Digital Infrastructure
item.description: India is rapidly integrating AI with its Digital Public Infrastructure to create scalable, citizen-centric and intelligent public services that enhance governance, inclusion and sector-specific innovation nationwide.

item.title: Singapore: SG$37 Billion Plan to Strengthen Research and Innovation
item.description: The S$37 billion RIE2030 plan deepens research capabilities, strengthens talent, drives high-impact innovation and advances the nation’s long-term economic and strategic priorities.

item.title: Vietnam: Emerging Hub for Data Centres and AI Infrastructure
item.description: Vietnam’s data centre market is rapidly expanding, driven by AI, cloud computing, and digital services, strongly supported by strategic cost advantages, national policies, and growing international investment.

item.title: Malaysia: Smart Renewable Energy Trading Infrastructure
item.description: Malaysia strengthens its regional renewable energy role through the Enegem trading platform, expanded grid interconnections and growing clean energy capacity supporting APG integration.

item.title: India: AI and Machine Learning to Transform Power Distribution
item.description: AI and Machine Learning are transforming India’s power sector, enabling smarter, consumer-focused and efficient distribution networks while supporting operational excellence and long-term grid resilience.

item.title: Australia: Smart Network to Monitor Hail, Extreme Weather
item.description: South East Queensland’s HailNet project will monitor hail and wind over seven years to improve forecasting, infrastructure resilience, agricultural protection, and support data-driven decision-making in extreme weather events.

item.title: New Zealand–Australia: Empowering Clean Energy and Digital Innovation
item.description: Australia and New Zealand are deepening collaboration on clean energy and sustainable finance to accelerate the net-zero transition, strengthen resilience and create long-term economic opportunities.

item.title: Hong Kong: Civic Engagement to Strengthen Innovation
item.description: Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation is linking civic participation with community initiatives to reinforce a stable policy environment that supports long-term innovation and technological growth.

item.title: Indonesia: QRIS Boosts SME Growth and Financial Inclusion
item.description: Indonesia’s widespread adoption of QRIS is significantly boosting SME investment efficiency, promoting financial inclusion and supporting sustainable economic growth both domestically and internationally.

item.title: Singapore: ASEAN Universities Adapt to the AI-Driven Era
item.description: ASEAN university leaders are advancing coordinated strategies to integrate AI into teaching, research and campus governance while preserving trust, ethics and the human connections essential to education.
